---
title: "Render all tutorials"
output: html_document
---

Knit this file, or run its chunks, to make both versions of every tutorial in `tutorials/`. Tutorials are named like their lectures (`03_descriptive_statistics.Rmd`), with the topic as `title` and `Tutorial 3` as `subtitle`. Each tutorial is written once, with its solutions, and this file makes:

- the students' exercise sheet, `docs/tutorials/03_descriptive_statistics.Rmd`: the same file without the solutions, with an empty chunk where each piece of solution code was;
- the slides, `docs/tutorials/03_descriptive_statistics.html`, in the lecture theme, with one slide per exercise and a slide with its solution after it.

In a tutorial, everything inside a `::: solution` block counts as solution, text included. Everything else appears in both versions, including hints and code that students get, such as `set.seed()` or a helper function. A second `::: solution` block in the same exercise starts a new solution slide, and task text after a solution starts a new task slide. A solution slide gets smaller text with `::: {.solution .smaller}`. The weekly assignment sits in a box, `::: {.assignment .alert .alert-info}`: the `alert` classes draw it on the exercise sheet (darkly theme), `assignment` on the slides.

Everything after the assignment box (or after a heading with "Weekly assignment" in it) is the weekly assignment, and a tutorial never contains its solutions, so the slides can be published at any time. If a `::: solution` block comes after that point, rendering stops with an error that names the tutorial.

On the slides, `## 1. Distributions` becomes a section slide and `### 1.1 A normal distribution` a slide; a `##` part without exercises (`## Setup`) is an ordinary slide. Horizontal rules (`---`) only appear on the exercise sheet.

The slides are rendered from a temporary file next to the lectures, because they need `slides_setup.R`, `theme-dark.css` and `fonts/`. Its name starts with `tutorial_`, so `render_all.Rmd` never takes it for a lecture, and it is deleted afterwards. Rendering stops at the first tutorial that fails, and the error names it.

## Reading a tutorial

`read_tutor()` splits a tutorial into its YAML header and its body. `classify()` records for each line of the body whether it belongs to a code chunk and to which solution block (0 for none), and it marks the lines that open or close a solution block.

```{r reading}
read_tutor <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8")
  fences <- which(lines == "---")
  list(yaml = lines[seq_len(fences[2])], body = lines[-seq_len(fences[2])])
}

yaml_field <- function(yaml, field) {
  line <- grep(paste0("^", field, ":"), yaml, value = TRUE)[1]
  sub('^[a-z]+: *"?(.*?)"? *$', "\\1", line, perl = TRUE)
}

classify <- function(body) {
  n <- length(body)
  chunk <- logical(n)
  sol <- integer(n)
  fence <- logical(n)
  in_chunk <- FALSE
  in_sol <- FALSE
  block <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    line <- body[i]
    if (!in_chunk && grepl("^:::+ *\\{?\\.?solution", line)) {
      block <- block + 1L
      in_sol <- TRUE
      fence[i] <- TRUE
      sol[i] <- block
      next
    }
    if (!in_chunk && in_sol && grepl("^:::+ *$", line)) {
      in_sol <- FALSE
      fence[i] <- TRUE
      sol[i] <- block
      next
    }
    if (grepl("^```", line)) {
      chunk[i] <- TRUE
      in_chunk <- !in_chunk
    } else {
      chunk[i] <- in_chunk
    }
    if (in_sol) sol[i] <- block
  }
  data.frame(line = body, chunk = chunk, sol = sol, fence = fence)
}

squeeze <- function(x) {
  blank <- x == ""
  x[!(blank & c(FALSE, head(blank, -1)))]
}
```

## The exercise sheet

Each solution block becomes one empty chunk if it contains code, and disappears if it is only text. Classes on headings, such as `{.smaller}`, are only for the slides and are left out.

```{r sheet}
student_lines <- function(d) {
  out <- character(0)
  i <- 1
  while (i <= nrow(d)) {
    if (d$sol[i] > 0) {
      rows <- which(d$sol == d$sol[i])
      if (any(grepl("^```\\{r", d$line[rows]))) out <- c(out, "```{r}", "", "```")
      i <- max(rows) + 1
    } else {
      line <- d$line[i]
      if (!d$chunk[i] && grepl("^#+ ", line)) line <- sub(" *\\{[^}]*\\} *$", "", line)
      out <- c(out, line)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  squeeze(out)
}
```

## The slides

The slides get the YAML header and setup of the lectures. `lecture_file`, `lecture_label` and the QR code are set again after `slides_setup.R`, so that they point to the tutorial.

```{r slides}
slide_header <- function(topic, number, html) {
  c("---",
    sprintf('title: "%s"', topic),
    sprintf('subtitle: "Tutorial %s: exercises and solutions"', number),
    'author: "Dr Massimiliano Canzi"',
    "output:",
    "  revealjs::revealjs_presentation:",
    "    theme: black",
    "    css: theme-dark.css",
    "    highlight: zenburn",
    "    mathjax: null",
    "    incremental: false",
    "    transition: fade",
    "    background_transition: fade",
    "    self_contained: true",
    "    reveal_options:",
    "      width: 1050",
    "      height: 700",
    '      slideNumber: "c/t"',
    "      showSlideNumber: all",
    "      controls: true",
    "      touch: true",
    "      transitionSpeed: fast",
    "      navigationMode: linear",
    "---",
    "",
    "```{r setup, include=FALSE}",
    'knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.6, out.width = "100%")',
    'source("slides_setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())',
    sprintf('lecture_file <- "tutorials/%s"', html),
    sprintf("lecture_label <- '\"tutorial %s\"'", sprintf("%02d", as.integer(number))),
    'slides_url <- paste0("https://mcanzi.de/ws26_statistics/", lecture_file)',
    "qr_uri <- qr_for(slides_url)",
    "qr_css <- if (nzchar(qr_uri)) sprintf('url(\"%s\")', qr_uri) else \"none\"",
    "options(width = 70, pillar.print_min = 10, pillar.print_max = 10)",
    "```",
    "")
}

slide_style <- function(footer) {
  c("",
    "<style>",
    "  :root {",
    sprintf('    --footer-text:  "%s";', footer),
    "    --qr:           `r qr_css`;",
    "    --lecture:      `r lecture_label`;",
    "  }",
    "</style>",
    "")
}

slide_end <- function(rmd) {
  c("",
    "## Slides and exercises",
    "",
    '<div class="qr-block">',
    '<img src="`r qr_uri`" alt="QR code linking to these slides">',
    "<div>",
    "<p>These slides</p>",
    '<p class="qr-link">mcanzi.de/ws26_statistics/<wbr>`r lecture_file`</p>',
    "<p>Exercise sheet (R Markdown)</p>",
    sprintf('<p class="qr-link">mcanzi.de/ws26_statistics/<wbr>tutorials/%s</p>', rmd),
    "</div>",
    "</div>")
}

slide_lines <- function(d, footer) {
  setup <- which(grepl("^```\\{r setup", d$line))
  if (length(setup)) {
    end <- setup[1] + which(grepl("^```\\s*$", d$line[-seq_len(setup[1])]))[1]
    d <- d[-(setup[1]:end), ]
  }
  is_h2 <- !d$chunk & grepl("^## ", d$line)
  is_h3 <- !d$chunk & grepl("^### ", d$line)
  h2 <- which(is_h2)
  h3 <- which(is_h3)
  has_ex <- logical(nrow(d))
  for (k in seq_along(h2)) {
    nxt <- if (k < length(h2)) h2[k + 1] else nrow(d) + 1
    has_ex[h2[k]] <- any(h3 > h2[k] & h3 < nxt)
  }
  out <- character(0)
  exercise <- ""
  reopen <- FALSE
  styled <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    line <- d$line[i]
    if (d$fence[i] && grepl("solution", line)) {
      classes <- setdiff(regmatches(line, gregexpr("\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*", line))[[1]], ".solution")
      number <- regmatches(exercise, regexpr("^[0-9.]+", exercise))
      title <- if (length(number)) paste(number, "Solution") else "Solution"
      attrs <- if (length(classes)) paste0(" {", paste(classes, collapse = " "), "}") else ""
      out <- c(out, "", paste0("## ", title, attrs), "")
      reopen <- FALSE
      next
    }
    if (d$fence[i]) {
      reopen <- nzchar(exercise)
      next
    }
    if (!d$chunk[i] && line == "---") next
    if (is_h2[i]) {
      exercise <- ""
      reopen <- FALSE
      out <- c(out, sub("^## ", if (has_ex[i]) "# " else "## ", line))
      if (!styled) {
        out <- c(out, slide_style(footer))
        styled <- TRUE
      }
      next
    }
    if (is_h3[i]) {
      exercise <- sub("^### +", "", line)
      reopen <- FALSE
      out <- c(out, paste("##", exercise))
      next
    }
    if (reopen && nzchar(line)) {
      out <- c(out, paste("##", exercise), "")
      reopen <- FALSE
    }
    out <- c(out, line)
  }
  squeeze(out)
}
```

## Making both versions

`check_assignment()` stops if the weekly assignment contains a solution.

```{r make}
check_assignment <- function(d, path) {
  box <- which(!d$chunk & (grepl("^:::+ *\\{.*\\.assignment", d$line) | grepl("^#+ .*weekly assignment", d$line, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  if (length(box) && any(d$sol[box[1]:nrow(d)] > 0)) {
    stop(basename(path), ": the weekly assignment contains a solution. Tutorials never include solutions to the weekly assignment.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

make_tutorial <- function(path, out_dir) {
  tutor <- read_tutor(path)
  d <- classify(tutor$body)
  check_assignment(d, path)
  rmd <- basename(path)
  html <- sub("\\.Rmd$", ".html", rmd)
  number <- sub("^Tutorial +", "", yaml_field(tutor$yaml, "subtitle"))
  topic <- yaml_field(tutor$yaml, "title")
  writeLines(c(tutor$yaml, student_lines(d)), file.path(out_dir, rmd), useBytes = TRUE)
  tmp <- paste0("tutorial_", sub("\\.Rmd$", "_slides.Rmd", rmd))
  on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
  footer <- sprintf("Tutorial %s: %s", number, topic)
  writeLines(c(slide_header(topic, number, html), slide_lines(d, footer), slide_end(rmd)), tmp, useBytes = TRUE)
  xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, list(input = tmp, output_file = html, output_dir = out_dir, quiet = TRUE))
}
```

```{r render, message = TRUE}
out_dir <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "docs"))
out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tutorials")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
tutorials <- list.files("tutorials", pattern = "^[0-9]{2}_.*\\.Rmd$", full.names = TRUE)
for (tutorial in tutorials) {
  message("Making ", basename(tutorial))
  make_tutorial(tutorial, out_dir)
}
```

```{r made}
made <- file.path(out_dir, c(basename(tutorials), sub("\\.Rmd$", ".html", basename(tutorials))))
knitr::kable(data.frame(file = basename(made), updated = format(file.mtime(made), "%d %b %Y %H:%M")))
```
